hello.text: Pip's Curiosities! Herbs, rumours, and the occasional miracle. What'll it be?

choices.text: Distract him and pocket a crystal.

rumor.text: Treasure loves high places, dark places and places people forget. Look for a faint golden glimmer. Oh, and the braziers on the hill? Fire doesn't care who carries it, but it does go out if you dawdle.

robbed.text: ...Hm? Sorry, I thought I saw a bird. Anyway!
